questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 Which of the following statement(s) is/are true regarding Single Page Applications (SPA) and Progressive Web Apps (PWA)?
options: SPAs load entire web pages from the server for each user interaction.
PWAs can be installed on a user's device and accessed from the home screen.
SPAs often rely on client-side routing to update the content dynamically.
PWAs always require an internet connection to function.
SPAs may result in faster user experiences as they avoid full-page reloads.
PWAs use service workers to enable offline capabilities.
correct_answer: PWAs can be installed on a user's device and accessed from the home screen.
SPAs often rely on client-side routing to update the content dynamically.
SPAs may result in faster user experiences as they avoid full-page reloads.
PWAs use service workers to enable offline capabilities.

questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 Identify the correct statement(s) about the behavior of promise chains in JavaScript.
options: A "finally" block always comes at the end of the promise chain.
Every "catch" block must always be preceded by a "then" block.
A promise chain may consist of a number of "then" blocks.
The "finally" block always gets executed, irrespective of the promise outcome.
correct_answer: A promise chain may consist of a number of "then" blocks.
The "finally" block always gets executed, irrespective of the promise outcome.
